name: Voxtral-Mini-4B-Realtime-Arabic
summary: Voxtral Mini 4B Realtime Arabic > [!Note] > See a space live demo directly in your browser here powered by this ONNX checkpoint.

usage.code:
pip install --upgrade vllm "mistral-common[audio]"

vllm serve mistralai/Voxtral-Mini-4B-Realtime-Arabic

import torch
from transformers import VoxtralRealtimeForConditionalGeneration, AutoProcessor
from mistral_common.tokens.tokenizers.audio import Audio
from huggingface_hub import hf_hub_download

repo_id = "mistralai/Voxtral-Mini-4B-Realtime-Arabic"

processor = AutoProcessor.from_pretrained(repo_id)
model = VoxtralRealtimeForConditionalGeneration.from_pretrained(
    repo_id, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device_map="auto"
)

audio_file = hf_hub_download(
    repo_id=repo_id,
    filename="assets/bank-take-2.wav",
    repo_type="model",
)
audio = Audio.from_file(audio_file, strict=False)
audio.resample(processor.feature_extractor.sampling_rate)

inputs = processor(audio.audio_array, return_tensors="pt")
inputs = inputs.to(model.device, dtype=model.dtype)

outputs = model.generate(**inputs, do_sample=False)
print(processor.batch_decode(outputs, skip_special_tokens=True)[0])

overall.note: Weighted mean of the available scorecard axes. Missing axes are excluded, not treated as zero. Coverage is shown so a sparse score is not mistaken for a complete one.

openness_morality.note: The score counts only what the record can currently evidence. Unchecked training data and code add nothing; they are not treated as closed.

performance.note: Not measured. No current benchmark is recorded.

research_citation.note: Not measured. No current research benchmark is recorded.

syndication.note: Independent listings, not quality. The model's own host has weight 0.

scorecard.method: Openness/Morality is computed from current release terms. Performance/Intelligence is the model's current task or benchmark result. Citation/Research uses current research benchmarks and does not claim citation accuracy. Syndication is current independent listings. The axes are independent; a missing score is not zero.
